name: Rocking H Dumpsters
summary: Roll-off dumpsters based in Franklin, TX. The service area list includes Bryan, College Station, Hearne, Madisonville, Calvert, Franklin, Kurten, Wixon Valley, Iola, and other towns. Item pages publish the prices. Those pages do not list a separate Bryan or College Station rate.
accepted: The item pages do not publish an allowed-item list. Tires are an additional $10 to $25 each, and the price varies by tire size. Appliances with Freon are an additional $20 each.
prohibited: The item pages say they do not accept heavy fill such as rock, gravel, stone, dirt, sand, brick, concrete, asphalt, or rubber pellets. They do not accept liquids, paint, batteries, asbestos, harmful chemicals, flammable liquids, or other items classified as environmental hazards.
gaps: Which landfill rate applies ($32 or $73 per ton)

offers.fit: Item page lists the size as 10 cubic yards. It does not list length, width, or height.
offers.deliveryLabel: Fuel surcharge based on distance to the jobsite. Amount not published.
offers.shortNote: Up to 10 days. Tonnage is $32 or $73 per ton. The page does not say which rate applies. Included tons are not stated.
offers.note: Item page lists $295 for a 10 cubic yard dumpster. Days are up to 10 days. Rent time extension is $5 per day. The page says rentals can be kept for a maximum of 3 months. Tonnage is $32 or $73 per ton. The spec line says depending on landfill, and the description says the price is determined by the nearest landfill to the jobsite. The page does not say which rate applies, and it does not state included tons. A fuel surcharge is calculated from the distance to the jobsite. The amount is not published. Tax is not stated. The service area page says a fuel surcharge may be added outside the normal service area.
